newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinians accuse Israel of spiking gum.
newsitem.headline: Palestinians accuse Israel of spiking gum.

text.p: A Palestinian Authority official on Tuesday accused Israel of sending chewing gum spiked with aphrodisiacs and sterility-inducing drugs into the West Bank and Gaza Strip.

"Our inspectors found in a routine search of the market some gum with sexual pictures on the cover," Saleh Abdul-Aal, Director of Inspection and Monitoring for the Palestinian Authority, told Reuters.
"We sent it to the laboratory for checking. The results said this gum includes sexually stimulating hormones and it may generate sterility in women and men," he said.
Abdul-Aal said inspectors suspected the gum might be contaminated because wrappers on the three- to six-cent pieces of gum warned minors not to chew it.
An Israeli government spokesman called the charges "outrageous."
Abdul-Aal could not say how much gum or what brands were spiked. But he said Israel was the source.
"(They did this) in order to create internal problems in our community and to kill our Islamic and national values," he said.
